integrity: The invariant and oscillator reduction are derived directly from the source first-order flow. Uniform boundedness follows from an explicit energy estimate, and exponent sharpness follows from a positive energy lower bound on the zero-invariant family. The bundled numerical replay is supporting evidence only.
scientific_limitations: Exact scalar equality-constraint result for Euclidean mirror maps, zero Rayleigh friction, fixed positive augmented-Lagrangian penalty, and exact ideal scaling. It does not extend the improved feasibility exponent to arbitrary affine systems, nonlinear constraints, or non-Euclidean geometries.
title: A hidden constraint invariant doubles the scalar feasibility exponent in undamped ELR flow
